content.short: Holonym is a zero-knowledge privacy protocol.
content.description: Holonym centers on zero-knowledge concepts to bolster privacy in Web3 overall. By using zero-knowledge proofs, Holonym lets users prove wallet ownership without exposing private keys, enabling anonymous voting and participation across supported chains. For projects, it enables token distributions like airdrops to users without requiring KYC or other regulatory checks, reducing friction while preserving privacy and security.
